    # Convert angle from degrees to radians
    alpha_rad = math.radians(alpha)
    
    # Calculate half-widths and heights
    w_half = w / 2
    h_half = h / 2
    
    # Calculate the intersections using trigonometry
    x1 = abs(w_half * math.cos(alpha_rad)) + abs(h_half * math.sin(alpha_rad))
    x2 = abs(w_half * math.cos(alpha_rad)) - abs(h_half * math.sin(alpha_rad))

    intersected_area = max(0, min(x1, x2) - max(-x1, -x2)) * max(0, min(y1, y2) - max(-y1, -y2))

    # Convert angle from degrees to radians

    # Calculate half the lengths of the sides
    w_half = w / 2
    h_half = h / 2
    
    # Calculate the areas of the individual triangles formed by the intersection

def calculate_overlapping_area(w, h, alpha):
    # Convert alpha from degrees to radians
    alpha_rad = math.radians(alpha)
    
    # Calculate the half-lengths of the sides
    w_half = w / 2
    h_half = h / 2
    
    # Calculate the cosine and sine of alpha
    cos_alpha = math.cos(alpha_rad)
    sin_alpha = math.sin(alpha_rad)
    
    # Calculate the vertices of the rotated rectangle
    x1 = w_half * cos_alpha + h_half * sin_alpha
    y1 = -w_half * sin_alpha + h_half * cos_alpha
    x2 = -w_half * cos_alpha + h_half * sin_alpha
    y2 = w_half * sin_alpha + h_half * cos_alpha
    x3 = -w_half * cos_alpha - h_half * sin_alpha
    y3 = -w_half * sin_alpha - h_half * cos_alpha
    x4 = w_half * cos_alpha - h_half * sin_alpha
    y4 = w_half * sin_alpha - h_half * cos_alpha
    
    # Find the maximum and minimum x and y coordinates of the intersection
    min_x = max(-w_half, -x2, -x4)
    max_x = min(w_half, x1, x3)
    min_y = max(-h_half, -y2, -y4)
    max_y = min(h_half, y1, y3)
    
    # Check if there is any overlap
    if max_x > min_x and max_y > min_y:
        return (max_x - min_x) * (max_y - min_y)
    else:
        return 0

    cos_alpha = math.cos(alpha_rad)
    sin_alpha = math.sin(alpha_rad)
    
    # Calculate the half-diagonal lengths of the original and rotated rectangles
    diag_length = math.sqrt((w/2)**2 + (h/2)**2)
    rotated_w_half = abs(diag_length * cos_alpha) / 2
    rotated_h_half = abs(diag_length * sin_alpha) / 2

    area = 2 * (rotated_w_half * rotated_h_half +
                max(0, min(rotated_w_half + rotated_h_half, w) - abs(rotated_w_half - rotated_h_half)) / 2)
    
    return area

def intersection_area(w, h, alpha):
    # Convert angle from degrees to radians
    alpha_rad = math.radians(alpha)
    
    # Calculate half-widths and half-heights
    hw = w / 2
    hh = h / 2
    
    # Calculate the distances to the vertices of the second rectangle from the origin
    d1 = hw * math.cos(alpha_rad) + hh * math.sin(alpha_rad)
    d2 = hw * math.cos(alpha_rad) - hh * math.sin(alpha_rad)

    d4 = -hw * math.cos(alpha_rad) - hh * math.sin(alpha_rad)
    
    # Calculate the lengths of the segments where the rectangles intersect
    x_intersect = abs(d1 - d2)
    y_intersect = abs(d3 - d4)
    
    # Calculate the area of the intersection
    return x_intersect * y_intersect
